messages:
Noah Chen: Heads-up: SparrowX-8B bring-up (Llama->Gemma layout) showing subtle coherency drop after 40-60 tokens on QA prompts. Looks like a rotary-phase step that aligns with a tokenization ligature in a few cases.
Vera Lopez: Can you paste the conversion command + a tiny repro?
Noah Chen: Sure.
```
python convert.py --src llama-sparrowx-8b.ckpt --dst gemma/sparrowx8b.onnx --permute-heads interleave4 --quant int4 --export-tokenizer
```
Repro input: "What are the main causes of urban heat islands?"
Gold fp16: "...increased surface temperatures and reduced evapotranspiration."
Quantized int4: "...increased surface temperatues and reduced evapotranspiration." (weird extra character and phase shift around token 52)
Ibrahim Khan: That inserted control-like char suggests tokenizer export produced a different byte sequence (ligature or normalization issue) OR the converter remapped token ids incorrectly for a small subset.
Jun Park: Also check KV-cache alignment. If head interleave changes ordering but rotary angle table wasn't remapped, later attention with cached keys will mismatch.
Noah Chen: Ran two quick tests: 1) rerun conversion with `--preserve-tokenizer` -> control-char disappears but phase blip still present; 2) rerun with `--no-permute` -> both issues mostly gone. So two orthogonal failures.
Vera Lopez: Good triage. Suggestion: 1) enforce NFKC on tokenizer export and include tokenizer checksum in model metadata; 2) add converter option `--remap-rotary-and-kv` that remaps rotary angle buffers and KV scale tables to post-permute ordering before quantization.
Ibrahim Khan: For int4 quant specifically, per-head asymmetric scales can magnify small misalignments. During calibration, collect per-head stats before applying any head permute, then apply permutation to the scale arrays so they match runtime layout. Also add a small smoke test that checks KV cosine similarity at t=60 vs fp16.
Jun Park: Implementation plan: converter change (remap), optional runtime loader check (verify head-order checksum on load and auto-remap on mismatch), tokenizer NFKC CI test, and a short evaluation against our QA benchmark to ensure no ROUGE/EM regressions.
ci-bot: test/sparrowx-rotary-kv-smoke queued.
Noah Chen: I'll open a PR with failing->fixed unit test, calibration numbers, and perf note (remap is a conversion-time op, <0.25ms/token added in our bench). Owner: @Noah to implement, @Ibrahim to review quant calibration, @Vera to add tokenizer CI. Target: land to staging in 3 business days. :rocket:
